title: Validate composed reviews against the expected leaf worklist
summary: The findings-report validator gets an optional expected-composition manifest. It checks that selected leaves, versions, result order and legitimate skips match what the host chose. Duplicate producers are now rejected, and a composition with missing leaves must be reported as partial or failed instead of completed.
key_points: New optional -ExpectedCompositionPath checks super-skill and leaf IDs, versions, result order and skip reasons against a host-owned manifest
Duplicate producers and duplicate or returned-and-skipped IDs are rejected even without a manifest
Missing selected leaves require 'partial' if a non-failed report exists, otherwise 'failed'; budget exhaustion is not turned into a configuration skip
Coverage is the sum of non-failed leaf worklists and handles zero usable sub-results
Report JSON schema is unchanged; manifest-free callers are still supported but cannot certify completeness
